name: Trinity
description: A single-piece unibody high-performance toolhead with double 3628 fans for high-temperature chamber cooling. Features a balanced center of mass to reduce rail wear and a compact Y-axis footprint that fits within a Sherpa Mini extruder mount, making it suitable for dual-gantry setups.

physicalSpecs.material: Fiber-reinforced ABS, PC-PBT, high-Tg PC, annealed PET, or annealed PPS

features: Single-piece unibody construction for maximum stiffness
Double 3628 fans for high-temperature chamber cooling
Balanced center of mass reducing rail wear and deflection
Compact Y-axis footprint fits within Sherpa Mini mount
Bottom-braced hotend at heatsink base to minimize deflection
Compatible with 6mm and 9mm GT2 belts (GT3 not supported)
